text:
Hi, 

I'm interested in hiring the Aldermoor for my daughter's wedding, which is taking place on 8 May 2027, from 8.00am to 18:30. I need to know if there will be a chauffeur available to drive it and if it can be decorated with wedding ribbons.

I've attached my driving licence, which will be required for collection from your garage, along with a chauffeur.

Best wishes,
Willa Marrowby
